changes.title: Announcing: Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks
changes.detail: Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks is an open-source command-line tool that you run inside compatible Azure VMs. Backed by Azure Boost, the tool provides remote disk I/O and latency metrics and maps each disk inside your VM to the corresponding disk
